questions.stem_text: Which of the following facts was established prior to 1859, the year in which Charles Darwin published On the Origin of Species?

options.A: DNA provides the macromolecular basis of heredity.
options.B: Mendelian principles explain why some traits are dominant and others are recessive.
options.C: Prokaryotes include two major domains, the Bacteria and the Archaea.
options.D: There exist fossilized remains of species that have become extinct.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - There exist fossilized remains of species that have become extinct.

questions.stem_text: Which of the following would increase the rate at which a gas diffuses between the alveoli of the lung and the blood within a pulmonary capillary?

options.A: Decreasing the partial pressure gradient of the gas
options.B: Decreasing the solubility of the gas in water
options.C: Increasing the total surface area available for diffusion
options.D: Decreasing the rate of blood flow through the pulmonary capillary

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - Increasing the total surface area available for diffusion

questions.stem_text: Short-term changes in plant growth rate mediated by the plant hormone auxin are hypothesized to result from

options.A: loss of turgor pressure in the affected cells
options.B: increased extensibility of the walls of affected cells
options.C: suppression of metabolic activity in affected cells
options.D: cytoskeletal rearrangements in the affected cells

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - increased extensibility of the walls of affected cells

questions.stem_text: Targeting of a newly synthesized protein is most likely to require two different signal peptides for which of the following destinations?
Charles Darwin's proposed conditions for natural selection encompass all of the following with regard to a given population EXCEPT
questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - inheritance of both "fit" and "unfit" genes

questions.stem_text: The first point of entry of water at the roots of a monocot plant is through the cytoplasm of cells of the
All of the following might be found in connective tissue EXCEPT
Which of the following sets of reactions occurs in the stroma of the chloroplast in plant cells?
Which of the following most accurately describes a retrotransposon?

options.A: A DNA sequence that can move from one site in the genome to another without replicating
options.B: A DNA sequence that can be deleted from the genome without consequence
options.C: A DNA sequence that replicates via an RNA intermediate
options.D: A DNA sequence that replicates via a protein intermediate

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - A DNA sequence that replicates via an RNA intermediate

questions.stem_text: Based on the characteristic population curves that result from plotting population growth of a species, the most effective means of controlling the mosquito...

options.A: maintain the population at a point corresponding to the midpoint of its logistic curve
options.B: opt for zero population control once the K value of the curve has been reached
options.C: reduce the carrying capacity cif the environment to lower the K value

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - reduce the carrying capacity cif the environment to lower the K value

questions.stem_text: All of the following statements about plant embryogenesis are correct EXCEPT:

options.A: The suspensor is derived from the basal cell.
options.B: Cotyledons are derived from the apical cell.
options.C: Shoot apical meristem formation occurs after seed formation.
options.D: Precursors of all three plant tissue systems are formed during embryogenesis.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - Shoot apical meristem formation occurs after seed formation.
